def reformatted_value(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value)

    # Find the final contiguous number in the cell.
    m = re.search(r"(\d+)$", text)
    if not m:
        return text

    last_number = m.group(1)
    preceding = text[:m.start(1)]

    # Match the demonstrated CH02A1456 -> 1456CH02 case:
    # when the part before the final number ends with a single A after a two-digit code,
    # treat that A as a separator rather than part of the moved suffix.
    if re.search(r"\d{2}A$", preceding):
        preceding = preceding[:-1]

    return last_number + preceding
